name: sedan-drive
description: Procedural three.js sedan you can drive on a test track or through any real place built from OpenStreetMap.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp index.html 'Drive Real Map.html' Drive.html Sedan.html drive-map.js road-layout.js minimap.js building-fronts.js osm-query.js vector-fallback.js radio.js touch.js sedan-model.js vaz-model.js three-d-stage.js dist/ && cp -r vendor models dist/
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx --yes serve@14.2.4 -l 5174 dist
scripts.proxy:kv: cd proxy && npx --yes wrangler@4.159.0 kv namespace create AREAS --update-config
